system.model: gemma4:26b via local Ollama; configurable through OLLAMA_MODEL
system.preference_demo: m041: Sam never takes meetings before 11:00am; applied to m043

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition and reason; deterministic rules handle obvious cases and the LLM handles the remaining contextual cases.
capabilities.observable: Prints decisions for all 100 messages, reports rule-handled and LLM-handled counts, and ends with undecided: 0; writes decisions.json and performance.json.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, decision events tagged cap=R1; performance.json

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in earlier inbox messages and records the source message ids used.
capabilities.observable: Prints a grounded draft for m008 using m003 as the retrieved earlier source; source ids are recorded in the grounded-reply trace.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl, read events followed by a grounded_reply event tagged cap=R2

capabilities.name: Gate irreversible actions
capabilities.claim: Never executes send or delete in dry-run mode and requires explicit approval for an irreversible proposal.
capabilities.observable: Shows SEND and DELETE proposals blocked by dry-run; no irreversible output is produced by the dry-run.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated scheduling preference and applies it after a process restart.
capabilities.observable: Stores m041's no-before-11:00 preference, creates a fresh PreferenceStore, then identifies m043's 09:00 request as a conflict and proposes 11:00 or later.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json and trace.jsonl preference_applied event tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects hostile instructions inside untrusted messages, refuses them, flags them, and reports the attempted action without executing it.
capabilities.observable: Reports seven detected threats as REFUSED and FLAGGED, including m017, m024, m021, m045, m039, m023 and m047.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates exactly three panes for pending actions, flagged messages, and commitments, with cited commitments and surfaced scheduling conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json; the output reports 70 pending actions, 7 flagged messages, 6 commitments and 1 scheduling conflict.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json, and dashboard_generated event tagged cap=R6

capabilities.name: Follow-up tracker
capabilities.claim: Finds sent messages unanswered for at least three days and drafts a follow-up.
capabilities.observable: Prints qualifying follow-up candidates with message_id, days_waiting and draft; the current run identifies m044 and uses the explicit recipient name found in the source message when available.

capabilities.name: Inbox digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a compact digest of what needs attention, what can wait, and what was automatically archived.
capabilities.observable: Reports Needs attention: 10, Can wait: 60 and Auto-archived: 30; writes digest.json.

capabilities.name: Preference-aware scheduling
capabilities.claim: Evaluates a meeting request against a persistent preference and existing commitments, proposing an alternative when needed.
capabilities.observable: Reports that m043 at 09:00 violates the 11:00 preference and surfaces the Sep 15 15:00 conflict between m010 and m061.

capabilities.name: Thread summary
capabilities.claim: Uses the configured LLM to summarize a multi-message thread and identify its current open question with supporting source ids.
capabilities.observable: Prints an LLM-generated summary of t-launch, identifies the open pricing-approval question, and lists source ids from the supplied thread.
